dataset_title: Population as of 1 January by regions and self-governed units
notes: Reused existing capture of 2026-08-03; re-downloaded 2026-10-01 with identical bytes, so Geostat has not re-estimated 2015-2024. Stored at person precision (display format shows one decimal). 2025 onward census-based.

dataset_title: Population as of 1 January by 5-year age groups and sex
notes: National; sex by age group (0, 1-4, 5-9 ... 85+). Thousands stored at person precision. Total equals table 01 Georgia in every year. 2025 and 2026 are census-based; census recalculation footnote.

dataset_title: Population as of 1 January by age and sex (single years of age)
role: archived, not served in this stage
notes: National; single years of age 0..84 and 85+, exact persons, 2015-2026. Kept for school-age and pension-age cohorts in a later budget-linked stage. Census recalculation footnote.

dataset_title: Mid-year population by self-governed units
notes: Denominator of Geostat's rates. Equals the average of consecutive 1 January values except 2024, which stays on the pre-census basis (3,699.557 thousand).

dataset_title: Median age by sex
notes: Published median age; breaks at 2025 with the census. Census recalculation footnote.

dataset_title: Percentage of population aged 65 and over by sex
notes: Reproducible from table 02 within 1-decimal rounding. Census recalculation footnote.

dataset_title: Age dependency ratios
notes: Total, child and old-age dependency ratios; reproducible from table 02 within 1-decimal rounding. Census recalculation footnote.

dataset_title: Number of live births by regions and self-governed units
notes: Georgia, region and municipality rows. Registered-in-year basis; 1995-2013 retro-projection, from 2014 registered data. Starred city rows are separate in 2014-2016 only.

dataset_title: Crude birth rate (Live births per 1 000 population)
notes: Births per 1,000 mid-year population, carried as published from 2014; still recomputed from tables 09 and 04 within 1-decimal rounding. Steps at 2014 (method) and 2025 (census denominator).

dataset_title: Age specific fertility rates and total fertility rate (TFR)
notes: Age-specific rates per 1,000 women and total fertility rate; TFR equals 5 x the sum of the age-specific rates within 0.005. Steps at 2014 (method) and 2025 (census).

dataset_title: Number of deaths by regions and self-governed units
notes: Georgia, region and municipality rows. Registered-in-year basis; same retro-projection note as births. Starred city rows are separate in 2014-2016 only.

dataset_title: Number of infant deaths by age and sex
notes: Infant deaths, used to recompute the infant mortality rate.

dataset_title: Crude death rate (death per 1 000 population)
notes: Deaths per 1,000 mid-year population, carried as published from 2014; still recomputed within 1-decimal rounding. Steps at 2025 (census denominator).

dataset_title: Infant mortality rate by sex (infant deaths per 1,000 live births)
notes: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births. Early years stored at full precision; recent years rounded to 1 decimal.

dataset_title: Abridged life tables
notes: Abridged life tables. Its e0 differs from table 28 by up to 0.157 years because table 28 is actuarial from 2002.

dataset_title: Life expectancy at births by sex
notes: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes, males, females. Abridged life table before 2002, actuarial from 2002.

dataset_title: Natural increase by regions and self-governed units
notes: Equals births minus deaths in every year at Georgia level. Cell AB85 (C. Gori*, 2020) holds a stray 0 where births and deaths have no cell.

dataset_title: Natural increase rate (per 1 000 population)
notes: Per 1,000 mid-year population; recomputable within 1-decimal rounding.

dataset_title: Net migration (number and rate)
notes: Net migration and rate per 1,000. 1995-2011 retro-projection; from 2012 Ministry of Internal Affairs border police data.

dataset_title: Number of immigrants and emigrants by age and sex
notes: Year-stacked blocks. 2002-2011 retro-projection; from 2012 border police data. Its totals are checked against table 33; age detail is not served.

dataset_title: Number of immigrants and emigrants by sex and citizenship
notes: Year-stacked blocks from 2012; border police data; by citizenship and sex.

dataset_title: Metadata: Population
notes: Last update 2026-04-24.

dataset_title: Metadata: External Migration
notes: Last update 2026-04-24. Defines immigrant and emigrant by the 183-days-in-12-months rule.

dataset_title: Metadata: Births
notes: Last update 2026-03-27. Counts births registered in the reference year.

dataset_title: Metadata: Deaths
notes: Last update 2026-03-27. Counts deaths registered in the reference year.

dataset_title: Population of Georgia by administrative-territorial units and sex (as of November 14, 2024)
notes: Census count at the 14 November 2024 reference date: Georgia 3,929,581 (males 1,881,004; females 2,048,577). Excludes occupied territories; confidential cells are flagged in the file. Anchor for the census check.
